registration.deadline: 60 days after installation for eligible residential registered coverage; exceptions and product-specific warranty terms apply, including jurisdictions where registration is not required.
registration.who_may_register: Homeowner or installing dealer for Amana, as its official page states; Goodman/Daikin-hosted registration form also provides a role for someone registering on behalf of the homeowner/customer.
registration.portal_accepts_dealer: yes - Amana says homeowner or installing dealer may register; Goodman/Daikin-hosted form offers `I am registering on behalf of the homeowner/customer`.
registration.terms_allow_third_party_preparation: uncertain - please check; portal roles support owner/dealer/representative submissions, but separate permission for an outside service or automated preparation is not stated.

date_code.status: published for most products; verify by model
date_code.format: Goodman and Amana state that the ten-digit serial identifies production timing; Goodman says that for most products the first four digits are YYMM (year then month), e.g. `1306` means June 2013. Product-specific exceptions may exist.
